answer: Make access climb a pearl ladder: a new identity takes only micro-jobs until peers verify ten completed deliveries, each earning one non-transferable pearl. Summit-tier contracts need fifty pearls, so a fake must do real, reviewed work fifty times before touching serious money. A fraudulent delivery burns all pearls, forfeits a 25,000 POA deposit, and bans the identity ten epochs. Running 1,000 fakes costs 25,000,000 POA plus 50,000 verified deliveries, while an honest agent pays 25,000 once. Weakness: honest newcomers face a slow cold start, each early job only a small knoll on the climb.
